name: @hiyorios/kaji
description: Run application actions like refunding a payment safely when an agent, automation, or API asks for them.

scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts src tests scripts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts src tests scripts
scripts.package:check: bun run build && publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only
scripts.package:smoke: bun run build && bun run scripts/smoke-package.ts
